claim_boundary: This boundary records a non-goal drift and promotion readiness matrix tied to the bounded ROADMAP non-goal contradiction inventory. The runtime metadata, Markdown corpus, and plugin docstring scans and CI promotion-gate workflow coverage are recorded separately, and the intentional promotion workflow is recorded separately. The contradiction-remediation report is recorded separately. This boundary does not claim joined runtime/plugin/docs/paper scope proof or owner review signoff.
